name: 3.5" TFT LCD Touch Display
fullName: 3.5-inch 480x320 SPI / 8-Bit Parallel Color TFT LCD Shield with Touchscreen
tagline: High-resolution full-color graphical display shield with resistive touch support
description: A 3.5-inch color TFT display with 480x320 pixel resolution capable of rendering 65,000+ vibrant colors, graphical UI dashboards, route maps, and real-time telemetry. Built with an ILI9486 / ILI9488 controller and an integrated SD card slot.

specs.operatingVoltage: 3.3V to 5V DC (onboard LDO and logic level converters)

wiringNote: Plug directly onto Arduino UNO header as a shield or wire SPI lines (MOSI, MISO, SCK, CS, DC).
commonMistakes: Using slow bit-bang software SPI instead of hardware SPI
Forgetting to read and pass the correct LCD Driver ID in tft.begin(ID)
